comment: Variation of bare-hand-silver-ring-one-weapon-form: a dwarf lord has two AT_WEAP attacks, so uhitm.c hmonas() sets gt.twohits to 1 and then 2. The first swing checks the right hand alone, which wears no ring, and hits; the second checks the left hand, whose silver ring sears the manes northwest of the hero.
